$comment: FNO music map — starting values from 20-Music-Scene-Entries.md §2/§5 as ruled by Dan. Seconds. trigger = a screen id (screen:menu, screen:opening-credits, screen:console, …) or a node id (node:<id>) entered; stop_on = input ids (start-new, start-load, skip-to-menu, choose:<option id>) or screen ids that fade the cue out. No loops on any screen where the player reads and decides. A cue may carry a gain (0-1) applied to that cue only, and stop_fade: per-signal fade-out seconds that override fade_out for that stop signal. All numbers are tunable without a rebuild; cues marked provisional are expected to move after playtest 2. Nothing here enters the ledger, the log, or the replay.

cues.note: FNO-DEPLOY (doc 40 item 1): Orbit of Hope (refrain) under the wall credits from its quiet start, once; the film before it carries its own Orbit of Hope. Fades over 2 s when the run-out starts (the `opening-runout` signal), 0.4 s under Continue's quick fade to the title. The M00c `opening` cue (Orbit of Hope under the prose scroll) is retired with that scroll.
Dan: the refrain loop 1:00 → 1:52 stands. Fades over 2 s on Continue; over 1 s on New Campaign (M01), under the prologue cue's 1 s fade-in.

M01 (treatment 28 §6, M01 handoff Part 2): Orbit of Hope under the prologue. The prologue always follows the menu, so the menu loop is what is playing at New Campaign: it fades over 1 s (its stop_fade) while this cue starts the track from 0:00 with a 1 s fade-in. One screen id for every plate, so the cue carries across Continue without restarting; it runs out naturally if the player reads longer than the track. Stops with a 1.5 s fade as the scenario card dissolves into the room; the room bed and effects start with the room.

Playtest 2 (note 9): Mission in Danger Drum Background at cue gain 0.75 (25 % lower). Runs once through the stabilization report, the rule, the return briefing and the decision; silence after 2:06 is intended. Tune the start offset first, then the fade on Choose.
Dan's ruling: start at 1:30. Runs out naturally at 1:46; no retrigger for the IX-A briefing. Alternative if too short in play: start 64.0.
